designs.note: Cuttlefish main all rejected (fake labels, invented squid bodies); argonaut backup drew one ribbed spiral shell without the animal, so titled SPIRAL SHELL; caption cropped off.
One whole refractor on a tripod; double frame and small marks cropped off; brass not visible in ink and mount is altazimuth, so ANTIQUE TELESCOPE.
Fine-line stacked tenements over a market lane, horizon edge, white tee; nothing plainly Hong Kong, so TENEMENT BLOCKS; faint background city lifted to paper.
Trumpet main all rejected (fake text, no trumpet); saxophone backup drawn dark on grey, flattened to dark-on-white so one ink prints white line on a black tee; no parts drawn, so SAXOPHONE.

minutes_note: Generation ran as three queued runs one after another (main 12 images, then slot 1 backup and slot 4 backup, 3 each), about 4 min an image on 4 cores. Choosing and one-ink processing ran during generation right after each image was saved; process counts only the time after the last image. generate_sdxl.py ran unchanged.
lesson: Lightning reads 'study sheet' and 'patent sheet' as a lettered plate: four of six main seeds for A and D were full of fake labels. A single object with no sheet words (shell, saxophone, telescope) comes out clean; it also ignored 'white chalk on black' in five of six seeds.
